svg.title: Euler stability for exponential decay
svg.desc: The exact solution of y prime equals negative y with initial value one is exp of negative t. Euler iterates equal one minus h raised to n. Three panels have identical axes: h equals 0.25 gives positive decay, h equals 1.5 gives artificial sign changes with decaying magnitude, and h equals 2.2 gives growing oscillations.

g.text: A decaying equation, three numerical behaviours
coloured points: Euler iterates; segments join the points
All panels use the same time and value scales.
Magnitude decays only for 0 < h < 2; nonnegative iterates require 0 < h ≤ 1.
